title: The Last Shelter
intro: Wrath of God threatens your entire battlefield. Keep two creatures after it resolves.
hint: Activated abilities stay on the stack even when their source has been sacrificed.
explanation: Sacrifice Selfless Spirit as a cost. Its ability gives your other creatures indestructible before Wrath of God destroys creatures. Sacrifice itself does not count as destruction.

title: One Breath Left
intro: You are at 2 life. Lightning Bolt is targeting you for 3 damage.
hint: You can stop the spell, or gain life before the damage resolves.
explanation: Either Counterspell targeting Lightning Bolt or Healing Salve targeting yourself keeps you alive. Both resolve on top of Bolt.

title: A Bear Against Lightning
intro: Your 2/2 Grizzly Bears is targeted by Lightning Bolt. Keep it on the battlefield.
hint: Creature damage is compared to toughness when state-based actions are checked.
explanation: Giant Growth makes Grizzly Bears 5/5 until end of turn. Three damage is marked, but less than five toughness, so it survives.

title: Spell or Creature?
intro: Wrath of God is on the stack. Which counter actually has a legal target?
hint: Read the targets: Wrath of God is a sorcery, not a creature spell.
explanation: Negate counters the noncreature spell Wrath of God. Essence Scatter cannot target it. Casting requires both legal timing and a legal target.

title: Hexproof Arrives Late
intro: Murder targets your Hill Giant. Its target was legal when cast; can you change that?
hint: Increasing toughness cannot stop a spell that says “destroy.”
explanation: Heroic Intervention gives your Hill Giant hexproof. On resolution, Murder checks its target again, finds it illegal, and does not resolve. Giant Growth does not prevent destruction.

title: Protection Is Not Exile
intro: Swords to Plowshares targets Grizzly Bears. Your Spirit can protect from destruction—but this is exile.
hint: Indestructible only prevents destruction. Hexproof can make an already-targeting opponent spell illegal on resolution.
explanation: Selfless Spirit cannot prevent exile. Heroic Intervention grants hexproof; Swords to Plowshares loses its target and fails to resolve.

title: An Unavoidable Blade
intro: Doom Blade is targeting your Grizzly Bears. You have a combat trick and a counter.
hint: Doom Blade destroys regardless of a creature’s toughness.
explanation: Giant Growth cannot prevent destruction. Counterspell can stop Doom Blade before it resolves. If the spell resolves, the bear dies.

title: Into Your Hand
intro: Murder targets Hill Giant. Your objective is to keep it out of the graveyard this turn.
hint: The creature need not remain on the battlefield to be saved.
explanation: Unsummon moves Hill Giant into its owner’s hand. Murder loses its target and does not resolve. Giant Growth cannot stop Murder.

title: The Counter War
intro: Your Lightning Bolt would finish your opponent at 3 life—but their Counterspell is on top.
hint: Dispel targets instant spells; Counterspell itself is an instant.
explanation: Dispel counters the opposing Counterspell. Your Lightning Bolt remains on the stack and deals lethal damage to the opponent.

title: Two Bolts, Two Answers
intro: You have 2 life. Lightning Bolt and Shock both target you. One answer is not enough.
hint: Gaining three life alone leaves you at zero after both spells. Countering only one also leaves lethal damage.
explanation: Use Healing Salve on yourself and Dispel on either instant. Five total incoming damage exceeds the life gain; countering one spell reduces the total enough to survive.

title: Not Even Six Toughness
intro: Swords to Plowshares targets a 3/3 Hill Giant. Pumping it helps the opponent gain more life.
hint: Exile ignores how much toughness a creature has.
explanation: Giant Growth makes Hill Giant 6/6, but Swords still exiles it, and its controller gains 6 life. Counterspell is the reliable answer.

title: The Final Exchange
intro: Your Bolt would win at 3 opponent life. Their Counterspell stops it; another Bolt threatens your 2 life.
hint: You need BOTH survival and a clear path for your own lethal Bolt. Choose your Dispel target carefully.
explanation: Gain 3 life with Healing Salve and use Dispel on the opposing Counterspell, not their Bolt. Their Bolt deals 3 but you survive; your Bolt then resolves and wins.
